name: Noah Reed
source:
The youngest brother of the Reed family.

Most of the time, he is expressionless and doesn't show his emotions. Noah was abandoned by his father upon missing out on being the top student of the academy he attends. Because of this, he now secludes himself in his own room, only leaving to go to school. He's now cut off from everyone in the Reed house, and his brothers and the maids have no idea how to treat and approach him.

He loves to read, and will read anything that piques his interest. Since he quickly remembers what he reads, Noah is actually knowledgeable. While reading books, he becomes totally absorbed. So much so, that he doesn't realise when somebody is trying to talk to him. With his school being so strict, he hasn't dated a girl before. Noah hasn't attended any high society events yet. He's not interested in it, as well as in girls.

In front of others, he behave as though he has no interest in the chivalric order. In truth, however, he wants to join the chivalric order like his older brothers had.
